summary.headline: Behind target: orders at 99.7% and revenue at 90.1% of target for the week, with the quarter and year also running behind and revenue pace well under what's needed.

points.what: Weekly orders were 877 against a target of 880 (99.7% attainment) and weekly revenue was $65,271 against a target of $72,478 (90.1% attainment), both behind.
points.so_what: The quarter is also behind target, so this week did not close the gap.

points.what: Revenue fell 2.9% and AOV fell 3.2% WoW, while orders fell only 0.6% WoW.
points.so_what: The revenue decline is coming mostly from lower order value rather than fewer orders.

points.what: YTD revenue attainment is 94.3%, a gap of $66,995, and the required weekly run-rate to hit the full-year target is $81,791 versus a current 8-week run-rate of $63,221.
points.so_what: At the recent pace, the full-year target is out of reach without a higher run-rate.

points.what: New customer signups rose 8.0% WoW and 9.8% YoY to 257, while orders were down 0.6% WoW.
points.so_what: Signup growth is currently outpacing order growth.

points.what: The required weekly revenue run-rate to hit the full-year target is $81,791, well above the current 8-week run-rate of $63,221.
points.so_what: Unless the run-rate rises, the full-year revenue target will not be reached.

points.what: QTD revenue attainment is 96.9%, a gap of $12,511, with 7 weeks left in the quarter.
points.so_what: The quarter remains behind the pace needed to reach the full-quarter target of $884,086.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of 2026-04-20 is up 0.4 pp YoY even though it fell 1.1 pp WoW.
points.so_what: Returns remain higher than the same week last year despite the recent week-over-week improvement.

points.what: Weekly orders reached 99.7% of target (877 vs 880) while weekly revenue reached 90.1% of target ($65,271 vs $72,478).
points.so_what: Orders were nearly on target but revenue missed by a wider margin this week.

points.what: QTD revenue attainment is 96.9%, a gap of $12,511, with 7 weeks left in the quarter.
points.so_what: The quarter is behind the pace needed to reach the full-quarter target of $884,086.

points.what: YTD revenue attainment is 94.3%, a gap of $66,995, and the required weekly run-rate for the rest of the year is $81,791 versus a current 8-week run-rate of $63,221.
points.so_what: The recent pace is well below what is needed for the rest of the year to hit the full-year target.

points.what: APAC orders fell 7.3% WoW, contributing -30 orders and 600% of the total change, the largest negative contributor by region.
points.so_what: APAC's decline was the single biggest drag on the week's order total.

points.what: EMEA orders rose 27.6% WoW, contributing +43 orders to the total change.
points.so_what: EMEA's growth offset part of the decline from other regions.

points.what: Facebook orders fell 28.1% WoW, contributing -16 orders and 320% of the total change, the largest negative contributor by traffic source.
points.so_what: Facebook's pullback was the main source of the order decline within traffic channels.

points.what: AOV fell 3.2% WoW to $86.34, though it remains up 6.8% YoY.
points.so_what: This week's revenue decline is tied more to lower order value than to fewer orders.

points.what: Cancellation rate fell to 13.8%, down 0.7 pp WoW and down 1.5 pp YoY, both good.
points.so_what: Each point of cancellation is worth $757 in revenue, so the drop adds back revenue that a higher cancellation rate would have removed.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of 2026-04-20 fell to 10.3%, down 1.1 pp WoW, but is up 0.4 pp YoY.
points.so_what: Despite the week-over-week improvement, returns remain above the same week last year.

points.what: New customer signups rose to 257, up 8.0% WoW and 9.8% YoY, while orders fell 0.6% WoW.
points.so_what: Signup growth is running ahead of order growth this week.

anomaly flag acknowledged in the summary
